item.title: Michigan Senate Democratic primary race remains too close to call as El-Sayed holds narrow lead – US politics live
item.summary: The former public health official has slight lead over congresswoman Haley Stevens, but vote count could continue well into the day El-Sayed holds narrow lead in Michigan Senate primary but race too close to call In some non-primary news: Max Miller , the beleaguered US Republican representative from Ohio , has vowed to defy a rising groundswell of resignation calls from his own party over domestic abuse allegations after his ex-father-in-law, Bernie Moreno , a GOP senator, said he was unfit to serve in Congress . Miller – who married Emily Moreno at Trump’s club in Bedminster, New Jersey, in 2022 – has been accused of holding a gun to her head and scalding her with boiling water. Their toddler daughter, who was born in 2023, is also said to have suffered a broken collarbone due to his actions. Continue reading...
